_comment: Data shared by run-campaign.sh and run-campaign.ps1: the labels of the protocol modes
(matrix §5) and the points of vigilance per provider (matrix §4 and §6).
One file for both scripts — prose duplicated across two languages diverges at the
requiredParams records, PER MODEL, the parameters for which a model demands one specific
value (kimi-k2.6 and gpt-5.6-sol and claude-sonnet-5 refuse any temperature other than 1;
gpt-5.6-sol demands reasoning_effort none with function tools). Per model and not per
provider: gpt-4o-mini, same provider, rejects reasoning_effort outright — a provider-level
pin would break its campaign. Only MEASURED values go in, dated in the notes; the
human-readable twin is the 'Per-model mandatory parameter values' section of
candidateModels records, PER PROVIDER, the successors a dated catalogue review (2026-09-19, then 2026-10-07) found on the
vendor's own API for the default — each with the reason it is a candidate and the red it is expected to
show. `run-campaign.sh --candidates` (`-Candidates`) runs them after the default, same modes, on the automatic
path only. A campaign is what promotes a candidate to default; the review alone never does.

openai.label: OpenAI

candidateModels.why: Top tier above Sol (10 / 50 $/M, 2026-09-04). Effort low…max with no `none`: the modes that pair function tools with reasoning measure whether Sol's `reasoning_effort: none` workaround is unnecessary or impossible there.

Listed by the API on 2026-10-07, the 6 generation of the default's own tier. Keeps `reasoning_effort: none`, so Sol's two pins carry over unchanged (requiredParams): 11/1 on its first run, the red being M9 at the mandated temperature 1.
The small tier of the 6 generation, listed on 2026-10-07. Same two pins as Sol; 12/12 on its first run.

Listed on 2026-10-07. Behaves like gpt-6-astra, not like gpt-6-sol: no `reasoning_effort: none`, so function tools are refused on chat/completions — M2 (messages array) and M5 red until the dialect speaks /v1/responses.

notes: Generic target of the `LlmProviderFactory` fallback: a green campaign here indirectly validates Docker Model Runner, vLLM and LM Studio. Proven live on 2026-08-30: 12/12 campaign against `api.x.ai` (`grok-4.6`, OpenAI dialect, base-url alone) — report under `custom-endpoints/`.
G-05 closed (LLM-01): the default moved from `gpt-4` (8 K context, retirement 2026-10-23) to `gpt-5.6-sol`.

Current models refuse `max_tokens` (2026-08-30 campaign: ten modes red on that one field). The OpenAI dialect writes `max_completion_tokens` since that date — accepted by the earlier generations too (verified on `gpt-4o-mini` the same day).

`gpt-5.6-sol` refuses any temperature other than 1 (`'temperature' does not support 0 with this model`) — same class as `kimi-k2.6`, same remedy: the catalog pins it for this model (requiredParams) and the report header carries the value used.

`gpt-5.6-sol` reasons by default and refuses function tools on chat/completions as long as `reasoning_effort` is not explicitly `none` (measured 2026-08-30, `none` unblocks the call). The catalog pins it for this model (`requiredParams`); M7 keeps probing thinking with its own explicit effort.

`gpt-6-astra` refuses any temperature other than 1 (`'temperature' does not support 0 with this model. Only the default (1) value is supported`, measured 2026-09-21 — first candidate run 2/10 on that cause alone) and, unlike Sol, has NO `reasoning_effort: none`: pinning it as for Sol turned the run into 3/9 (`does not support 'none' with this model. Supported values are: 'low', 'medium', 'high', and 'xhigh'`). Without it, function tools on chat/completions are refused outright (`Function tools with reasoning_effort are not supported for gpt-6-astra in /v1/chat/completions. To use function tools, use /v1/responses`) — the Sol workaround is impossible there, which is what the review of 2026-09-19 asked the campaign to settle. The catalog pins the temperature only; M5 is expected red until the dialect learns /v1/responses. Both refused reports (06:35, 06:52) are kept as the trace.

Catalogue read of 2026-10-07 (133 ids, 5 never campaigned in the current chat tiers): `gpt-5.6-terra`, `gpt-5.6-luna`, `gpt-6-sol` and `gpt-6-luna` answer exactly like Sol — `'temperature' does not support 0 with this model. Only the default (1) value is supported.` and `Function tools with reasoning_effort are not supported for <model> in /v1/chat/completions. To use function tools, use /v1/responses or set reasoning_effort to 'none'.` — and take Sol's two pins (requiredParams): 11/1, 11/1, 11/1 and 12/12. `gpt-6.1-sol` quotes the same sentence but refuses `none` (`'reasoning_effort' does not support 'none' with this model. Supported values are: 'low', 'medium', 'high', and 'xhigh'.`): pinned like `gpt-6-astra`, temperature only, 10/2 with M2 (messages array) and M5 red; its 3/9 report of 18:14, run with Sol's pins, is kept as the trace. M9 is the mode that moves at temperature 1: the default read `29`, `gpt-6-sol` `26`, `gpt-5.6-terra` `18` for 73 — model side, as on 2026-08-30 and 2026-09-21.

anthropic.label: Anthropic

candidateModels.why: New top tier (2026-09-01, 10 / 50 $/M). Thinking always on, forced `tool_choice` refused, temperature pinned like Sonnet 5 (requiredParams).
The default's own tier, one generation on (listed 2026-09-28). Thinking adaptive only, temperature pinned (requiredParams); 12/12 on its first run, 2026-10-07.

The small tier, listed on the day of the campaign (2026-10-07). Temperature pinned; 11/1, the red being the probe's own M9 check — the model answers `Seventy-three red`, the check looks for the digits.

Listed 2026-09-21. Temperature pinned; 10/2 — M5 and M6 come back empty because the API refuses the probe's wording (`stop_reason: refusal`, category `cyber`), which the provider reads as an empty answer. Not a default until that is told apart.

notes: Own dialect (Messages API): this is the provider carrying the most specific code.
M8 is **schema mandatory** — `output_config.format` has no `json_object` equivalent.
M10 only makes sense with an explicit breakpoint: without `cache_control`, Anthropic caches nothing (G-17). The harness enables it on its own here.
M4 must confirm the native SSE delivered by LLM-05 (G-20), not a buffered fallback.

Identity-linked keys require the `anthropic-workspace-id` header on every request (measured 2026-08-30). Declare `workspaceId` in the campaign JSON or pass `--workspace-id`; classic keys need nothing.

`claude-sonnet-5` refuses any explicit temperature other than 1 (`temperature is deprecated for this model`, measured 2026-08-30: 1 and omission pass, 0 and 0.7 do not) — same class as `kimi-k2.6` and `gpt-5.6-sol`, same remedy: the catalog pins it for this model (requiredParams), the report header carries the value used.

Catalogue read of 2026-10-07 (14 ids; the endpoint publishes context, output cap, effort levels and thinking types per model — see served-models.json). Four more models refuse a pinned temperature in the same words (`temperature is deprecated for this model.`): `claude-opus-5`, `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-haiku-5-5` — pinned to 1 (requiredParams); 12/12, 10/2, 12/12, 11/1. The listing itself needs the workspace header on an identity-linked key, and `orkeon llm models` cannot send it: the list was read with a direct call. `GET /v1/organizations/workspaces` answers that same key with the workspace ids.

A refusal is NOT an empty answer, and the provider reads it as one (measured 2026-10-07): on `claude-opus-5-5` the probe's M5/M6 prompt (`the sealed probe code … cannot be guessed`) comes back HTTP 200 with `content: []`, `stop_reason: "refusal"` and `stop_details: {category: "cyber", explanation: …}` — 3 of 4 M5 and 4 of 4 M6. `AnthropicLlmProvider` does not read `stop_reason`, so the report shows `no tool call in the reply:` followed by nothing. On that model those reds measure the classifier meeting the probe's wording, not tool calling — `claude-sonnet-5`, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, `claude-opus-5` and `claude-haiku-5-5` answer the same prompt. `claude-fable-5-1` shows the same empty M6 since 2026-09-21 (three more today), but one direct call with the same wording was answered (`end_turn`, a text block): its cause is not established.

azure.label: Azure OpenAI
notes: Two URL modes to exercise separately: deployment (`api-version`) and v1 GA (LLM-07, G-06).
The only provider where **M4 must also cover the degraded case**: missing `BaseUrl` ⇒ typed error, never a `NullReferenceException` (D-01).
No public catalog: deployments are declared in the campaign JSON, the wildcard does not apply.

ollama.label: Ollama

candidateModels.why: Same size class as llama3.2 with tools + thinking. Needs `ollama pull qwen3.5:4b` first — models are pre-provisioned, this script pulls nothing.

notes: Zero cost: this is the campaign that serves as the kit's shakedown before any spending.
The only **M6** path (text protocol) in the fleet.
**Native M5** is now possible via `/api/chat` (LLM-07, G-10) — this campaign is what confirms it live.
The effective context is capped by `num_ctx`, well below the advertised 128 K: to be measured in M11.

together.label: Together AI

candidateModels.why: Together's own replacement target (2026-09-14 removals): 1M context, tools + JSON, 0.15 / 0.50 $/M — a seventh of the default's price.
Together's replacement for gpt-oss-20b: 262K, tools + JSON, 0.17 / 0.25 $/M.

notes: The default `Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo` is text-only: its red M9 is the D-03 proof (2026-08-30 campaign). No vision companion was declarable until 2026-09-21: the 4 vision models tested on 2026-08-30 (`Qwen3-VL-8B`, `Qwen2.5-VL-72B`, `Llama-4-Scout`, `Llama-4-Maverick`) were all non-serverless on the measured tier — paid dedicated endpoint required, failure report archived as proof. `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash`, the replacement candidate, reads the image in serverless (M9 ✅ twice on 2026-09-21) and is the companion since.

LLM-10 (2026-09-19) sent the context window as `max_tokens` here, betting on `context_length_exceeded_behavior: truncate`; the 2026-09-21 campaign measured the default at 2/9/1 (`inputs tokens + max_new_tokens must be <= 131073`) — two of three serverless engines refuse regardless of the flag, the third clamps on the buffered path only. The window entries left the catalogue the same morning (`fb00251a`), the 4096 fallback is back (the field omitted means 2048 at Together, measured), and the 2/9/1 report is kept as the trace.
Endpoint and default model up to date. One M1–M5 pass is enough.
Together serves DeepSeek-V4-Pro at 512 K where DeepSeek serves it at 1 M — a service gap to verify in M11.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
notes: To **revalidate** despite the age of its proof: LLM-01 changed its default model and LLM-02 refactored it onto the capabilities base.
M7 must confirm the `reasoning_content` round-trip — without it the API returns a 400.
M8 must confirm the “word *json* absent from the prompt” guard.

Long the only provider in the fleet without a vision model, until `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` (measured 2026-08-30: it reads a base64 image). Since V4.1 Flash (2026-09-10) vision is native on the Flash tier: the default `deepseek-flash` sees and the experimental companion is retired — M9 runs on the default, no `visionModel`. `deepseek-v4-flash` and `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` name retired models the API temporarily routes to V4.1 Flash (vendor pricing page, 2026-09-19); the 2026-09-07 campaign under the old name is to be replayed on `deepseek-flash`.

Catalogue read of 2026-10-07: two ids, `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`, and the endpoint now publishes their options — 1 048 576 context, 393 216 output, effort levels `low` / `high` / `max` with `high` the default; image input on Flash only. `deepseek-v4-pro` campaigned for the first time: 11/1, the red being M9 (text-only, D-03 — it answers nothing about the image after 45 s). The default is 12/12 for the third campaign in a row.

kimi.label: Kimi (Moonshot AI)

candidateModels.why: Flagship (1M, 3 / 15 $/M). Temperature pinned to 1 (requiredParams); top_p, n and both penalties fixed; no `thinking` field accepted — the M7 toggle is expected red until the dialect learns it.

The coding model, listed on 2026-10-07 (262 144 context, image + video + reasoning). Temperature pinned to 1 (requiredParams); 12/12 on its pinned run, cache read — the only Kimi model with every mode green that day.

notes: `kimi-k2.6` **refuses any temperature other than 1** (`invalid temperature: only 1 is allowed for this model`) — the catalog pins it for this model (requiredParams), and the report header carries the value actually used. A Kimi verdict is not reproducible in the same sense as a verdict at temperature 0.
Two regional endpoints with **separate accounts**: `api.moonshot.ai` (international, default) and `api.moonshot.cn` (mainland China).
G-11 closed: check that the host resolved in the report header is the expected one.
The `moonshot-v1-*` series counts input + output within the same bound — its “8 K” is not an 8 K input window.

2026-10-07, two acts. At 18:09 the account was suspended (`exceeded_current_quota_error`, HTTP 429, `suspended due to insufficient balance`): the retry policy treats that 429 as a rate limit and spends its whole budget on every mode, so the run was stopped after nine minutes and nothing was archived — the refusal quotes the organisation and key ids. Topped up, the campaign ran at 19:15: `kimi-k2.6` 10/1/1 — M8 again, `json_object` comes back fenced in markdown as on 2026-09-21, and M10 without a cache breakdown; `kimi-k3` 11/1 — M2 on the messages array this time, cache read (7936 tokens, ratio 0.97), bare JSON. The catalogue lists four ids: `kimi-k2.6`, `kimi-k2.7-code`, `kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed` (262 144 context) and `kimi-k3` (1 048 576), all with image, video and reasoning.

`kimi-k2.7-code` mandates temperature 1 like its siblings, and the provider's own remedy hides it on half the paths (measured 2026-10-07): on a buffered call `KimiLlmProvider` reads `invalid temperature: only 1 is allowed for this model`, retries once with the mandated value and logs it — so M1, M5 and M7 pass at temperature 0 — while the two streaming paths have no such retry and surface the refusal (M3 and M4 red, 9/2/1 at 19:17, kept as the trace). Pinned in requiredParams; 12/12 one minute later, cache read (7936 tokens, ratio 0.98). A pre-pass on buffered modes alone cannot see a mandated temperature on this provider.

qwen.label: Qwen (Alibaba DashScope)

candidateModels.why: The cheap tier of the 3.8 generation: 1M, image + video input, 0.16 / 0.47 $/M.
The top tier, alias of `qwen3.8-max-0902`.

notes: Distinct international endpoint: `https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1` (G-12 closed).
The only provider where the thinking budget is wired (`thinking_budget`): M7 is richer here than elsewhere. Validated live on 2026-08-30 (12/12, reasoning trace returned).

The DashScope implicit cache only engages above a high threshold: 0 cached tokens with the historical probe prefix (~2050 tokens, 3 measurements) but `cached_tokens: 4352` at 5809 prefix tokens (2026-08-30). The M10 probe sends ~8200 tokens since that date; the clean run archives 6528 cached, ratio 0.81.

2026-10-07: an international key (`sk-ws-…`) is refused by the compiled endpoint (`dashscope.aliyuncs.com`, 401 `Incorrect API key provided`) and by the US one; it is served by `dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com` only — declare `baseUrl` in the campaign JSON, as the header of every report shows. 172 ids listed (ids only). `qwen3.7-plus`, `qwen3.8-flash` and `qwen3.8-max` are all 12/12 (the M2 red of `qwen3.8-flash` on 2026-09-21 did not come back); `qwen3.7-max` 11/1 (M9: text-only, `Unexpected item type in content`) and `qwen3.7-flash` 11/1 (M2 on the messages array) campaigned for the first time.

mistral.label: Mistral AI

candidateModels.why: Listed 2026-10-07: 524 288 context, tools + reasoning + vision, reasons by default. Needs the streaming fix of that day (content deltas arrive as arrays of typed chunks) — 10/2 before it (18:14), 11/1 after (19:37, M10).
262 144 context, tools + reasoning + vision, default temperature 0.3; 11/1 on its first run (M9 reads `7` for 73) and its cache is read (8192 tokens, ratio 1.00).

notes: Run **without `--base-url`**: that is how, and only how, one verifies live that G-14 is closed — a bare `mistral-*` model must no longer head for `localhost:11434`.
The host shown in the report header is the proof: `api.mistral.ai`, not `localhost`.
`mistral-medium-2604` restricts `reasoning_effort` to `['high', 'none']` (measured 2026-08-30) — M7's default `low` is refused, hence the `m7Effort: high` in requiredParams.

M10: the usage carries `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens` but the value stays 0 on an identical 5812-token prefix called twice (3 measurements, 2026-08-30). The field exists, the implicit cache does not engage — vendor red, not an Orkeon defect. Confirmed on the long prefix: still 0 at ~8200 tokens (2026-08-30).

Identifiers mix aliases and dated snapshots: confirm the id on the official model card before freezing it. The compiled default was exactly that trap: `mistral-medium-3-5-26-04` (a concatenation of the `-3-5` alias and the `26-04` vintage) was never served — `Invalid model`, measured 2026-08-30, corrected to `mistral-medium-2604`.

2026-10-07: the account is no longer rate-limited — the default is 11/1, its 2026-08-30 line, M10 still `0 cached` (the 2/10 of 2026-09-07 and 2026-09-21 measured the account). The catalogue (55 ids) publishes each model's context, capabilities, aliases and `default_model_temperature`: 1 for `mistral-medium-2604` and `mistral-large-4`, 0.3 for `mistral-small-2603`, `mistral-large-2512`, the ministral family and `codestral-2508`; `mistral-medium-2604` is now listed as an alias of `mistral-medium-latest`, with `mistral-medium-3-5` and `magistral-medium-latest`. `mistral-large-4` and `mistral-small-2603` restrict `reasoning_effort` to `high` / `none` like the default (`m7Effort`, requiredParams).

`mistral-large-4` reasons by default and streams `delta.content` as an ARRAY of typed chunks (123 array deltas for 4 strings on a count to five, 2026-10-07): the text stream threw `InvalidOperationException: The requested operation requires an element of type 'String', but the target element has type 'Array'` (M3 red, archived 18:14) and the chat stream dropped the trace and the first words of the answer. Both streams read the two shapes since that day; replayed on the fix at 19:37, M3 is green (50 chunks) and the run is 11/1 — that report was produced on the working tree carrying the fix, before it was committed, so the commit its header names is the one the fix sits on top of. Its cache is read where the default's is not (7660 tokens, ratio 0.92, at 18:14 — then 0 on the replay, M10 red).

huggingface.label: HuggingFace

candidateModels.why: Tools on three routed providers where the default has them on one of four: the routing-dependent reds of the 2026-09-07 sweep are what this run should stop showing.

notes: The router resolves the identifier to the partner (the campaign M9 answers under the name `Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-Turbo`): the default is text-only, its red M9 is the D-03 proof, the companion `Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct` brings the complement.

The compiled default `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`, long reported unreachable through the router, is CLEARED: live M1 measured on 2026-08-30 (20 tokens, 1.5 s). The catalog aligns with it — the campaign validates what the platform delivers.
G-01 closed: the old `api-inference.huggingface.co` is removed, the default is `router.huggingface.co/v1`.
Also exercise a routing suffix (`:cheapest`, `:fastest`, `:<provider>`) — G-23.
The effective context and output depend on the routed provider, not on the model: `GET /v1/models` gives the values per provider.

zai.label: Z.AI (Zhipu GLM)

candidateModels.why: 2026-08-18, same price as 5.2. Thinking cannot be disabled: an M7 toggle-off red is model-level, not a transport fact.
0.15 / 0.50 $/M with image + video input — would also retire the `glm-4.6v-flash` vision companion.
The third model of the 5.3 family, listed since 2026-08-13 and campaigned on 2026-10-07: 12/12 — it sees, and its cache is read (8064 tokens, ratio 1.00).

notes: Traceability debt of its own: the only existing proof is a dated configuration comment. This campaign must produce an **archived output** for it.
To revalidate after LLM-02, which refactored it onto the capabilities base.

2026-10-07 (11 ids, ids only): `glm-5.2` 10/2 (M9 `1210`, M10 `0 cached`) and `glm-5.3` 10/2 (M2, M9 `1210`) unchanged; `glm-5.3-flash` 11/1 — M2 on the messages array, its first red in five runs; `glm-5.3-flashx` 12/12 on its first run. The three 5.3 models return no reasoning trace on M7 where `glm-5.2` does.

grok.label: Grok (x.AI)

candidateModels.why: Listed by the API on 2026-10-07 at the price of 4.6 (2 / 6 $/M, 0.5 cached). 11/1 on its first run: native tools, schema, vision and cache green, no reasoning trace returned on M7, and M6 red — it announces the tool call in prose instead of writing the block.

notes: Fourteenth provider, arrived on 2026-08-30 preceded by its own proof: 12/12 campaign against `api.x.ai` through the generic OpenAI dialect BEFORE the class existed (archived under `custom-endpoints/`). Every declared capability is a measurement from that campaign.
Keys carry the `xai-` prefix — the grok/groq near-homograph is exactly the confusion the factory's inference absorbs (`api.groq.com` refuses these keys, measured).
Implicit cache in the standard `cached_tokens` format (512 tokens, ratio 0.19 on the first M10 pass).

2026-10-07: `GET /v1/language-models` publishes modalities, prices and aliases for the 8 text models (`/v1/models` adds the image and video ids, 14 in all). `grok-4.6` 12/12 for the fifth campaign in a row; `grok-4.7` 11/1 (M6).

minimax.label: MiniMax

candidateModels.why: 1M context, image + video input, same 0.30 / 1.20 $/M as M2. Whether the `<think>` block still arrives inline on the OpenAI-compatible endpoint is the campaign's question.

notes: Fifteenth sheet, WITHOUT execution proof: integrated on 2026-08-30 from the vendor documentation, no key available. The first campaign is the pending proof — the Mistral lesson (compiled default never served) applies in full until a live M1 is archived.
Two regional endpoints with separate accounts: `api.minimax.io` (international, default) and `api.minimaxi.com` (mainland China) — same pattern as Kimi.

First attempt on 2026-08-30: valid international key, catalog served (`MiniMax-M2` live, generations up to `MiniMax-M3` listed), but Token Plan exhausted — every billed mode answers `insufficient_balance_error` (402), typed errors end to end. The transport is validated; the campaign remains the pending proof, to rerun once the account is topped up.

First campaign on 2026-08-30 (7/2/3 on `MiniMax-M2`, `sk-api-` key — `sk-cp-` keys are coding plans with their own quota). The three questions settled: (1) the trace arrives INLINE as a `<think>` block inside the content, no separate field — the Orkeon dialect extracts it to `reasoning_content` and re-injects it on replay as the doc requires; (2) no cache breakdown at 8k of prefix; (3) `response_format` accepted but NON-BINDING (schema ignored, json_object fenced in markdown) — the None declaration is a measurement.

M2 and M9 red: model behaviour (system ignored on both shapes; text-only, `I'm unable to view the image`). The VL family does not appear in the platform's `/models` catalog — but `MiniMax-M3`, listed there, reads the image (M9 ✅ twice on 2026-09-21): it is the vision companion since, and the candidate for the default. Its `<think>` block is split out like M2's (6 characters returned for 199 billed tokens on M1); M10 saw 128 cached tokens once (ratio 0.02) and no breakdown the second time.

2026-10-07 (8 ids, ids only: M2, M2.1, M2.5, M2.7 and their `-highspeed` twins, M3): `MiniMax-M2` 7/2/3 unchanged; `MiniMax-M3` 9/1/2 (M2 red, it sees, 128 cached tokens); `MiniMax-M2.7` campaigned for the first time — 8/2/2: text-only like M2 (`I'm unable to see the image`), system message ignored on both shapes, and the first full cache read on this vendor (8059 tokens, ratio 1.00).

gemini.label: Google Gemini

candidateModels.why: GA 2026-09-02, same 0.75 / 3.75 $/M as 3.7 Flash until 2026-12-31; the vendor labels 3.7 previous generation. First candidate for a default bump, on the three transports at once.

notes: Arrived **after** the 2026-07-27 audit: it carries no inherited G-xx gap, and its §6.13 sheet was opened without a campaign. This one is its first real execution proof.
**OpenAI-compatibility** endpoint (`generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai`) — neither the native Gemini API nor Vertex AI. The host carried by the report header is what confirms it.

**M8 is no longer ➖**: measured on 2026-08-30, the compatibility surface accepts `response_format` `json_object` **and** `json_schema`, schema validated server-side (`additionalProperties` included). The provider declares `JsonSchema` since that date — the warning it used to emit refused something that works.

M3/M4 stream in large blocks (~13 characters per event): a reply that is too short fits in a single chunk and reads like a buffered fallback. The probe asks for a hundred numbers since 2026-08-30 to discriminate (thirty were enough here, but claude-sonnet-5 coalesced thirty into a single delta).
M7 is **effort only** (`reasoning_effort` translated to `thinking_level`): neither toggle nor token budget, unlike Qwen.
The default model sees: M9 is exercised on it, with no companion vision campaign.

2026-10-07: the native listing (`GET /v1beta/models`, 62 ids) publishes each model's options — 1 048 576 context and 65 536 output on every Flash and Pro text model, default `temperature` 1, `topP` 0.95, `topK` 64, `maxTemperature` 2. The default and `gemini-3.8-flash` are 11/0/1, mode for mode as on 2026-09-21. `gemini-3.5-flash-lite` 12/12 — the only Gemini model of the day whose cache breakdown comes back (4077 cached tokens, ratio 0.51); `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` 10/1/1, the red being one M5 with no tool call that three replays did not reproduce.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter

candidateModels.why: Follows the direct Gemini candidate — the transport question is the same.

notes: First campaign on 2026-10-07 (LLM-09's pending proof): `google/gemini-3.7-flash` 11/1 and `google/gemini-3.8-flash` 11/1 — every mode green but M10. One model, three transports: direct Gemini is 11/0/1 the same day, the difference being M10 alone — the marketplace returns the cache fields with 0 where Google's own endpoint returns no breakdown at all.

Marketplace: 465 models on 2026-10-07 (445 on 2026-09-18), `vendor/model` identifiers are mandatory (`anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`), suffixes `:free` / `:nitro` / `:floor` / `:batch`, router slugs `openrouter/auto` (refused as a default: the served model drifts). Question 1, answered: the key carries the `sk-or-v1-` prefix.

mammouth.label: Mammouth AI

candidateModels.why: Follows the direct Gemini candidate — what the proxy lets through is the question.

notes: First campaign on 2026-10-07 (LLM-09's pending proof): `gemini-3.7-flash` 10/0/2 and `gemini-3.8-flash` 10/0/2 — every exercised mode green; M7 and M8 are ➖ because the provider declares neither capability, not because the proxy refuses them.

French multi-model subscription (12 / 24 / 72 € per month with 2 / 4 / 10 $ of API credits included, pay-as-you-go from the API settings). Bare vendor identifiers (`gpt-5.6-sol`, `claude-sonnet-5`, `gemini-3.7-flash`): always name the provider by baseUrl or by key, never by model name. 107 models on 2026-10-07 (100 on 2026-09-19); `GET /v1/models` publishes context and output cap per model — see served-models.json.
Question 1, answered: `tools` are passed through — M5 green on both Gemini ids and on `deepseek-v4.1-flash`.

Question 2, answered by direct calls: `response_format` is accepted, never refused. `json_object` returns bare JSON; a strict `json_schema` did NOT bind on `gemini-3.7-flash` (asked for prose, the reply starts in prose) — accepted but non-binding, the MiniMax case, so the None declaration stands.

Question 3, answered by direct calls: `reasoning_effort` is accepted. On `deepseek-v4.1-flash` the trace comes back in `reasoning_content` (46 reasoning tokens counted in `completion_tokens_details`); on `gemini-3.7-flash` no trace is returned. An EffortOnly declaration would need no parsing — it is not declared yet.
Question 4, answered: M9 green on the default and on `gemini-3.8-flash`.

Question 5, answered: `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens` is relayed (4076 cached tokens, ratio 0.51, on both Gemini ids), and the usage carries `cost`, `cost_details.upstream_inference_cost` and `is_byok` — the fields of OpenRouter's usage.
Question 6, still open: no 429 was met.
Question 7, answered: the key is `sk-` followed by 22 characters — covered by the `sk-` pattern.
Question 8, answered: `mammouth-recommended` echoes its own name, never the model behind it — one more reason it is refused as a default.
